facts.text: Dillard freezes tuition for each incoming student cohort's second year, ensuring four-year graduates face only one tuition increase.

sources.title: Tuitions & Fees | Cost of Attendance | Dillard University, HBCU
sources.quote: All incoming students will have their tuition frozen for their second consecutive academic year. The new pricing structure ensures that all students who graduate in four years will have only one tuition increase while matriculating.
